### Observed differences

- A01 and A03 disappeared from execution: each ran exactly once in every before-window trace (200 in 200) but appears in none of the 200 after-window traces. Conversely, A05 and A07 were newly executed: absent from all before-traces, each now runs once in every after-window trace (200 in 200). [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- The end of the flow was rewired. Before, every outgoing transition of A06 led to A01, every outgoing transition of A01 led to A03, and A03 sat at the final position; in the later window, every outgoing transition of A06 leads to A07, which now occupies the final position, while the previously unobserved A05 leads to A06 in all of its occurrences. [DIR001, DIR004, DIR003, POS002, POS005, REL012, REL013, REL014]
- Routing out of A02 changed: before, about 53 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions went to A06 and about 47 in 100 to A04; after, A06 is no longer a direct target — transitions split roughly 50/50 between A04 and the new A05. A02 now reaches A06 indirectly, mostly two steps later (gap 2 in about 51 in 100 after, versus a direct gap-1 edge in about 42 in 100 before). [DIR002, LAG001]
- Positions shifted accordingly: A06's mean normalized position moved from about 0.50 to about 0.75 (and became more uniform), and A05 sits around the middle of the trace (mean about 0.51). [POS004, POS003]
- The ordering style between A02 and its successor is preserved: after, A02 precedes A05 and A07 in about 52 in 100 traces with interleaved-or-repeated behaviour in the rest, closely mirroring the old A02–A01 relation (about 52/48 before). [REL007, REL008, REL001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural replacement at the tail of the process as a possibility: A01 and A03 stopped being executed, A05 and A07 were introduced, and the former chain A02 → A06 → A01 → A03 (with an A02 → A04 branch) became A02 → A05 → A06 → A07, with A07 as the new final activity and the A02 → A04 branch retained. Supporting signs: participation flipped completely for all four activities (200/200 to 0/200 and the reverse); successor profiles changed directly (A06 now leads to A07 instead of A01, A05 gained an edge to A06, A02 lost its direct edge to A06); relational items show the new chain A05 before A06 before A07 in all after-traces where the old chain A06 before A01 before A03 held in all before-traces; and the position and lag items agree with this reading. With 28 qualifying items against roughly 0.16 expected without change, chance cannot account for the evidence as a whole. Limitations: the many relational and positional items largely re-describe the same replacement rather than confirming it independently, and the evidence cannot rule out that the two windows simply sample different case variants of a heterogeneous process rather than a change in one process. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, REL002, REL004, REL010, REL012, REL013, REL014, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, LAG001]

Other differences: A02 occurs slightly more often per trace in the later window (about 2.0 versus about 1.9 occurrences, from outgoing-transition counts of 402 versus 375 over 200 traces each); this is minor and consistent with the replacement above. [DIR002]
